placementFailed.description: Set when the publication landed and re-placing the object into its regions did not.

placementFailedWorldViews.description: Where the regions are stale now. Present exactly when `placementFailed` is, and never empty.

applied.description: The fields now holding the source's value.

released.description: The claims given up to take it.

releasedPoints.description: The points whose own claim on the coordinate went with the object's, because the object's coordinate and its one visible point's are the same fact.

movedPoints.description: Those of them also put back on the coordinate the run offered.

releasedCredit.description: Whether taking the source's picture also dropped the credit the curator's own edit wrote for it.

fromSyncLogId.description: The run whose proposal was taken.

AcceptSourceResult.description: What taking the source's value for claimed fields did.

AdjacencyEdge.description: Two divisions that share a border.

focusBbox.description: Null while the division has no geometry.

AdministrativeDivision.description: An official boundary from GADM: a continent, a country, a province, down to a municipality.

AdministrativeDivisions.description: Divisions: roots, children or siblings; or a division's ancestors, from the root to the division itself.

curationState.description: The object's own state after the call, unchanged when `published` is false.

appliedFields.description: Always empty: an override never applies a held field.

claimedFieldsSkipped.description: Always empty, for the same reason.

appliedParts.description: Always empty: a held field of a part is a proposal too, and an override answers none.

fromSyncLogId.description: Always null, for the same reason.

heldLeftOpen.description: Always zero: an override answers no held row, so it leaves none open either. A row holding a proposal keeps its pointer and its own card through an override.

treasureLinksPublished.description: Links to the object's works shown to readers now.

withdrawalsReleased.description: Points the source had replaced, no longer shown now that their replacement is.

placementFailed.description: Set when the publication landed and re-placing the object into its regions did not.

placementFailedWorldViews.description: Where the regions are stale now. Present exactly when `placementFailed` is, and never empty.

admission.description: The verdict now standing: `admitted` after an override, `refused` after a confirm.

published.description: Whether this override also made the object visible. True only where the object was unread and the verdict was `override`: putting a gated arrival back is what publishes it (ADR-0025), while overriding the refusal of a visible object says nothing about whether anyone has read it.

regionId.description: The region the marking was limited to, or null for the whole object.

AllLocationsMarked.description: Every place of an object, or of it within a region, marked visited.

AllLocationsUnmarked.description: Every place of an object, or of it within a region, no longer marked visited.

AnchorPoint.description: The centre of the focus frame, [lng, lat]: where the camera goes for a frame that crosses the antimeridian.

missingSince.description: Null where a later run found the point again and cleared the flag.

decidedBy.description: Who last decided, read from the curation log under the log's own scope. Null where the act belongs to a region this reader does not cover, or predates the log.

AnsweredPoint.description: A lost point a curator has answered, which no reader sees as a result (#544).

name.description: The part as the record names it, which is what the curator saw on the card.

fields.description: The held fields written to the part now.

claimedFieldsSkipped.description: Held fields left as the curator wrote them, because the part's own claims hold them.

AppliedPart.description: One part publishing wrote to, such as a place renamed or a work re-attributed (ADR-0037).

AreaGeometry.description: An area as a simplifying read draws it: one piece or several.

AssertionArea.description: What an assertion is about, so a growing list stays readable.

AssertionKind.description: An `invariant` may match nothing; a `watch` is a number to watch rather than a debt, and cannot be accepted.

AssertionStatus.description: What today's number means beside the accepted one. `holding` is debt somebody has answered for; `unanswered` is a rule nobody has answered for yet.

path.description: The division's administrative path, root first.

hasCustomGeom.description: The region holds only a part of the division.

cancelled.description: False when no placement was running to stop.

AssignmentCancelled.description: A stop asked of a world view's placement.

sourceId.description: The one source placed, or null for every source.

AssignmentStarted.description: A placement of experiences into a world view's regions, started in the background.

status.description: The step: each point placed in its leaf regions, then carried up to their ancestors, then an experience's regions written from its points.

directAssignments.description: Points placed in the regions that contain them.

ancestorAssignments.description: Placements carried up to those regions' ancestors.

AssignmentStatus.description: A world view's placement as it stands. Only `running` is sent while no run is known since the server started.

AuthMessage.description: What registration and a resent verification answer, the same whether or not the address has an account.

similarity.description: The name match's trigram similarity, 0 to 1.

geoSimilarity.description: How far the division overlaps the leaf's geoshape, 0 to 1; null without a geoshape.

AutoResolveMatch.description: A leaf's best name match, and what resolving would do with it.

coverage.description: How much of it the matched leaves cover, 0 to 1.

parentMembers.description: The container's own divisions, and which of them its matched leaves would cover.

AutoResolvePreview.description: What resolving a container's unmatched leaves would do, without doing it. No screen calls it.

suggestedGroup.description: One of the groups the request offered, or null when none fits or the region should be split.

shouldSplit.description: The region spans more than one group.

splitGroups.description: When the region should be split: the offered groups it spans. Names the request did not offer are dropped.

context.description: Geographic or cultural context the model added.

sources.description: The pages a web search read.

BatchGroupSuggestion.description: Which group one region of a batch belongs to, as the model suggests it.

suggestions.description: By region name. A region the model did not answer for has no entry.

apiRequestsCount.description: The requests the model answered, twenty regions to a request. An answer that could not be read is counted and costed but suggests nothing; a request that failed before any answer is neither.

BatchSuggestions.description: Group suggestions for a batch of regions, and what they cost, summed over every request the batch made.

points.description: Pixel positions at the run's working size.

clusters.description: The two clusters on either side, lower label first.

BorderPath.description: A border between two clusters, traced on the working image.

old.description: The stored value the run found. Absent where there was none.

curatedConflict.description: A curator had claimed the field, so the stored value won on purpose.

held.description: The source's gate kept the write out of a row readers see, so a verdict is waiting (ADR-0025).

ChangedField.description: One field a run proposed to change.

name.description: The child to add, or the existing child the action is on.

sourceUrl.description: The child's Wikivoyage page, where one was found and verified.

verified.description: Whether the Wikivoyage page was found to exist.

ChildAction.description: One change a model proposes to a region's children.

added.description: How many of the division's children now sit in the region: the ones the call named, or all of them where it named none, less any whose assignment to an existing subregion failed.

removedOriginal.description: The division itself was taken out of the region, so it is not counted twice beside its children.

createdRegions.description: The subregions made for them; empty when they went in as division members.

UnrefuseContentsResult.description: What asking again about turned-down points and works did.

UserRole.description: What an account may do: read, curate, or administer.

UserSearchResult.description: One account whose name or email matched.

UserSearchResults.description: Up to twenty accounts, by display name.

ViewedTreasureIds.description: The works the reader has marked seen.

suggestedIds.description: Divisions the model read as inside the region on its map.

unclearIds.description: Divisions the model read as on the border.

regionMap.description: The region's map, as sent to the model.

divisionsMap.description: The numbered divisions, as a PNG data URL.

VisionMatchResult.description: A model's reading of which candidate divisions a region's map covers.

VisitedExperienceIds.description: The objects the reader has marked visited.

byExperience.description: The same places, keyed by the object id.

VisitedLocationIds.description: The places the reader has marked visited.

VisitedRegion.description: A region the reader has marked visited.

VisitedRegions.description: The reader's visited regions, newest first.

VisitedStatus.description: How far through an object's places the reader is.

held.description: Visible rows holding a change the gate kept out, answered per card rather than in a batch.

contents.description: Visible rows holding unread points or works.

WaitingCounts.description: What one source is holding, in the three kinds the review queue asks about.

WaitingSub.description: A gated sub-kind a `waiting` question groups (ADR-0025).

pct.description: The component's share of the map, in percent.

cropDataUrl.description: A crop of the map around it as a `data:` URL, or empty where the crop is fetched from `water-crop`.

WaterComponent.description: One patch of the map the run reads as water.

waterPxPercent.description: The share of the map read as water, in percent.

waterMaskImage.description: The water mask as a `data:` URL, sent by the Python pipeline.

WaterReviewRequested.description: The run, paused until the reviewer says which patches are water.

webSearchModel.description: The model id a request with web search now uses.

WebSearchModelSet.description: The model a request with web search uses, chosen.

kinds.description: Every kind the source asks, and any it kept before, by name.

WikidataCache.description: What a source keeps between runs.

kind.description: The kind cleared, or null for all of them.

WikidataCacheCleared.description: Kept answers dropped, so the next run asks the source again.

expired.description: Answers past their expiry, which the next run fetches again.

oldestFetchedAt.description: The oldest answer of this kind, which is what "how stale is this" means.

nextExpiresAt.description: When the soonest answer stops being used.

labels.description: A few of the questions themselves, newest first, so a kind is not just a word.

ttlMs.description: How long an answer of this kind stays fresh, in force now.

WikidataCacheKind.description: One kind of question whose answers a source keeps.

restamped.description: Kept answers re-dated from their own fetch time, which says whether the next run re-fetches five things or five hundred.

WikidataCacheTtlSet.description: How long one kind stays fresh, changed.

WikivoyageCache.description: A saved copy of the pages an extraction fetched, which a later one can start from.

WikivoyageCacheDeleted.description: A saved copy of the pages, deleted.

mapshapeIndex.description: The index of the shape's group in `mapshapes`.

WikivoyageShapeFeature.description: One shape the Wikivoyage page draws, as its Wikidata items outline it.

visited.description: Whether anyone had been there. The visit survives either answer (ADR-0022).

replacedMetres.description: How far away the source now offers this same part, in metres, rounded to two decimals. Null where it offers it nowhere.

WithdrawnPoint.description: A point the object lost, waiting on its own verdict.

claimed.description: The columns this edit took ownership of, which a later run no longer touches.

imageCredit.description: Who is named under the new picture. Present only where the picture changed, and null where Commons named nobody in time.

WorkEditResult.description: What a curator's correction to a work did.

folded.description: Echoed rather than assumed, so a layer cannot draw one fold with the other's data.

truncated.description: Present only when the read hit its cap. A density picture built from a subset is wrong rather than incomplete, so this is never silent.

locationId.description: Markers only: the pin's identity, for hover and for opening a card.

kindId.description: Markers only: what the pin is coloured by (`kindColors.ts` owns the palette).

locationCount.description: Folded only: how many places the pin stands for, which is the badge's number.

WorldPointsResponse.description: The map's points, one array per field, all of them the same length.

isDefault.description: The GADM world view itself, which cannot be deleted.

isPublic.description: False for an admin-only world view, which the listing hides from everyone else.

tileVersion.description: Bumped whenever the world view's tiles are rebuilt at unchanged URLs, so a tile URL carrying it misses the stale cache.

WorldView.description: A way of dividing the world into regions: GADM itself, or a hierarchy built over it.

WorldViews.description: The world views the caller may see, the default first.
